hazards.reason: Backfilling trg_customer_audience_update resolves the audience of every row of customer.
hazards.subject: trigger/customer/trg_customer_audience_update

statements:
CREATE TRIGGER "trg_customer_audience_update" AFTER UPDATE ON "customer" FOR EACH ROW
WHEN NEW."audience" IS NULL OR NEW."audience" NOT IN ('everyone', 'private', 'named')
  OR NEW."agent_access" IS NULL OR NEW."agent_access" NOT IN ('followRole', 'readOnly', 'none')
  OR NEW."effective_audience" IS NOT CASE NEW."audience" WHEN 'everyone' THEN NULL WHEN 'private' THEN CASE WHEN NEW."id" IS NULL THEN '[]' ELSE json_array(NEW."id") END WHEN 'named' THEN (SELECT json_group_array(audience_member.value) FROM (SELECT NEW."id" AS value WHERE NEW."id" IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT value FROM json_each(COALESCE(NEW."audience_named", '[]')) WHERE value IS NOT NULL) AS audience_member) ELSE CASE WHEN NEW."id" IS NULL THEN '[]' ELSE json_array(NEW."id") END END
  OR NEW."effective_agents" IS NOT NEW."agent_access"
BEGIN
  -- The @audience of Customer (D156, D182): the row's audience resolved into
  -- effective_audience and effective_agents, whatever writes the row.
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'customer.audience is none of everyone, private, named') WHERE NEW."audience" IS NULL OR NEW."audience" NOT IN ('everyone', 'private', 'named');
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'customer.agent_access is none of followRole, readOnly, none') WHERE NEW."agent_access" IS NULL OR NEW."agent_access" NOT IN ('followRole', 'readOnly', 'none');
  UPDATE "customer" SET "effective_audience" = CASE "customer"."audience" WHEN 'everyone' THEN NULL WHEN 'private' THEN CASE WHEN "customer"."id" IS NULL THEN '[]' ELSE json_array("customer"."id") END WHEN 'named' THEN (SELECT json_group_array(audience_member.value) FROM (SELECT "customer"."id" AS value WHERE "customer"."id" IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT value FROM json_each(COALESCE("customer"."audience_named", '[]')) WHERE value IS NOT NULL) AS audience_member) ELSE CASE WHEN "customer"."id" IS NULL THEN '[]' ELSE json_array("customer"."id") END END,
    "effective_agents" = "customer"."agent_access"
    WHERE "customer"."id" = NEW."id";
END
